paragraphs.zh: Form B displays a thermogram with a characteristic melting peak in the range from 110 to 130° C. The peak maximum typically lies in the range from 120 to 130° C. paragraphs.zh: 150 mg of tembotrione were dissolved in 0.15 ml of boiling methanol in a test vessel. The test vessel was sealed and placed in an ice-water bath and left there for about 40 mins. paragraphs.zh:
A saturated solution of about 50 mg of tembotrione in the solvents stated in Table 1 was prepared in a test vessel at the boiling point of the solvent. The test vessel was sealed and placed in an ice-water bath and left there for about 40 mins. In this manner, tembotrione was obtained in the form of crystals, which were isolated and analyzed by X-ray powder diffractometry (XRD). On the basis of the characteristic reflections, form A was identified.
TABLE 1
| Example | Solvent | Crystal form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | acetic acid | small prisms, needles |
| 3 | acetonitrile | prisms |
| 4 | dioxan | needles and prisms |
| 5 | tetrahydrofuran | small prisms |
| 6 | ethyl methyl ketone | prisms |
| 7 | pyridine | prisms |
| 8 | dimethyl sulfoxide | small prisms, needles |
| 9 | nitromethane | prisms |

notes: Page p08 is printed page 5 of the description of US20100041557A1 and is the first experimental page: it carries the tail of the form-B characterisation, the figure and instrument paragraphs, and then the worked examples from Example 1 to Example 15. LANGUAGE CONVENTION: this patent is in English. Per the shared briefing the source text is placed in 'zh' because build_enriched.py reads that key by name, and 'en' carries the same text verbatim, character for character, with no translation step; every paragraph note says so. Where a printed glyph cannot survive as plain text the same normalisation is applied to both fields and named in the paragraph's note: superscript 'st'/'nd' written as '1st'/'2nd', subscript H2O written 'H2O', and the long dash the page prints in 'Cu-Kalpha' written as a hyphen because the repo forbids that character anywhere. PARAGRAPH MARKERS: printed in bold inside square brackets and recorded that way. All thirteen were checked individually on the image at 3x, [0065] through [0077], and every one carries its brackets; only the OCR text layer strips them. The marker appears in the marker field alone and never inside zh, since build_enriched.py prepends it. The nine centred headings carry no marker at all and take a null marker, which verify.py provides for explicitly. The unnumbered table at the top of the page takes the marker of the paragraph that introduces it, in the continuation form the reference run uses. TABLES: three tables on this page, all of them results, and all three ride inside the zh and en of their paragraph as GitHub markdown, prose first, caption line then rows contiguous, with no blank line anywhere inside any zh or en on this page. (1) An unnumbered, unmarked eight-row table at the top of the left column, two columns, 2theta and d [Angstrom], attached to paragraph 0064 which is at the foot of p07; (2) TABLE 1 in the right column, three columns, Example / Solvent / Crystal form, eight rows for examples 2 to 9, attached to 0074; (3) TABLE 2 in the right column, four columns, Example / 1st Solvent / 2nd Solvent / Crystal form, four rows for examples 10 to 13, attached to 0075. Every column association was read off the image and not from the text layer, which walks each table column by column and would have paired example 2 with 'acetic acid' only by luck. No table starts or ends across a page break and no row is duplicated. NUMBERS: every mass, volume, temperature, time, 2theta value and d spacing on this page was read off the image at 3x or better and the text layer used only as a cross-check. The layer failed on numbers repeatedly and predictably, reading 0 as the letter O ('15.77 O.O7', '3.92 O.O2', '7.87, O.OS'), losing a decimal point ('15.40.2' for '15.4 plus-minus 0.2'), losing the subscript in H2O, and reading 2theta as the number 20. In every disagreement the image was taken as correct. NO DRAWINGS: there is no chemical structure, no reaction scheme and no diffractogram anywhere on this page. The page is prose and tables only, in two columns. The empty drawings array is therefore a finding and not an omission, and no structure was classified as invention route or prior art from a drawing because there was none to classify. On the prose evidence the classification is unambiguous anyway: Examples 1 to 15 are all headed 'Preparation of Form A' or 'Preparation of Form C', the two forms the patent claims, and are the INVENTION's own work; the comparative examples that are not according to the invention begin on p09. Paragraph 0066, which makes form B from n-pentanol, describes a modification the patent explicitly declines to claim (0063 on p07: modification B cannot be stably formulated). The illegible array is empty and that is a positive finding: the scan is clean, every glyph on the page including every digit in all three tables was resolved on the image, and nothing was reconstructed from context or from chemical expectation.
